Hi Elena / Novus procurement team,

Following our MAP kickoff last week, sharing the weekly legal/procurement docket so we have a single place for status, blockers, and owners. Short summary below and attached files: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.pdf and Order_Form_Novus_v2.xlsx.

- Order form: Draft with proposed SKUs and discount applied; pricing flagged for final approval from your finance team.
- Vendor setup: Vendor intake form submitted to Redwood billing; pending PO number and W9 from Novus.

Key open items / asks:
1) MSA: Flag on Section 6 (Data retention & audit logs) — Novus legal flagged a more restrictive retention window. If you provide the specific wording, we can route to Redwood legal for a quick pass. Owner: Elena / Novus legal. Target: 2027-06-08.
2) Order form: Confirm final billing address, legal entity name, and target effective date. Owner: procurement_novus@novushealth.com. Target: 2027-06-10.
3) PO & Vendor setup: Please share PO number and W9 to vendor-setup@redwood.com to complete vendor onboarding. Owner: procurement. Target: 2027-06-14.

Proposed next steps:
- If Novus can return a single tracked PDF with redlines today, Redwood legal will respond with comments by Tuesday.
- We can set a short call Thursday to lock the order form and finalize PO timelines.

Attaching: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.pdf, Order_Form_Novus_v2.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week if timelines align.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the tracked edits. 

Quick consolidated response and next steps: 
1) MSA redlines: Redwood legal reviewed Novus edits. We can accept the majority of your changes. For Section 6 (Data retention & audit logs) Redwood proposes a middle ground to address your compliance needs while preserving operational constraints:
   - Detailed request/response logs and KV cache metadata: retained for 12 months
   - Aggregated audit metrics and anonymized usage summaries: retained for 24 months
   - Redwood will commit to providing exportable audit reports on request to support your audits (subject to agreed SLAs).
Please confirm if that compromise is acceptable; if so, we will produce a clean MSA with that clause inserted and return for final signature.

2) Order form: I updated the order form with placeholders for billing entity and tax ID. Please confirm the billing entity exactly as you want it on file. Attached: Order_Form_Novus_v2.xlsx (updated).

3) SOC2 & invoice: Sean attached a SOC2 summary and a redacted sample invoice for your finance team here: https://redwood-internal/shared/reports/soc2-2027-summary.pdf.

4) PO & vendor setup: To keep on your target timeline, please share the PO number and W9 to vendor-setup@redwood.com by 2027-06-13. Once received, our billing team will complete onboarding within 3 business days.

5) Signature & close timeline: If the retention compromise is acceptable and you confirm billing details, we can route the final order form + MSA through DocuSign by 2027-06-10 and aim for a signed agreement and PO by 2027-06-13. DocuSign link (preview): https://www.docusign.com/na/sample-envelope/ENVELOPE-12345

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, Order_Form_Novus_v2.xlsx

Would you like a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk legal through the compromise language? Happy to join along with aditya.

Best regards,
